name: EPD requested in a revised offer from Deal Timeline -> Revise Offer regenerates the contract
description:
Objective: EPD requested in a revised offer from Deal Timeline -> Revise Offer regenerates the contract.
Preconditions: Open Offer epd lifecycle with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Offer epd lifecycle.
2. EPD requested in a revised offer from Deal Timeline -> Revise Offer regenerates the contract.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Revise Offer is rendered only after the Merchant Call is completed.
